answer: TideRidge Desk treats sybil resistance as a cost of attested work, not of names. Each identity must pass a timed challenge whose scarce words (for example saffron) cannot be mass-templated; peers then attest only when the text shows real judgment. A flood of clones still hits a canyon of grading capacity and sinks in an ocean of duplicate-hash rejection, so stake accrues to consistent, original labor.
